title: Kodansha USA Licenses The Pool, Subaru and Subaru, Kraken Mare, 5 More Manga
content: Kodansha USA Publishing announced new manga licenses during its panel at San Diego Comic-Con International on Saturday. The company also announced it will release a box set of the first six volumes of Saka Mikami 's The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity manga in spring 2027.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Now Streaming New Shonen Jump Revival Movie 10 Years After the Anime’s Finale
content: One Shonen Jump classic franchise has returned for a brand new movie ten years after its original TV anime run came to an end, and now fans can find it streaming with Crunchyroll to check it out for themselves.
author: ComicBook

title: Bleach Returns for Final Season After 14 Years With Explosive New Opening – Watch Now
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has officially returned for the anime’s fourth and final season after years of waiting, and a new opening and ending has kicked off this final era of the anime in style.
author: ComicBook

title: Evangelion is Creating The World’s Weirdest Chicken Sandwich
content: Neon Genesis Evangelion has long held the title for one of anime’s most cerebral properties. Shinji Ikari’s story has existed in various forms, but one thing has united them: you never quite know what you are going to get from the Evangelion offerings.
author: ComicBook

title: One Piece Finally Confirms Crunchyroll English Dub Release for Elbaph Arc
content: One Piece has been tearing its way through the anime’s take on the Elbaph Arc ever since it made its debut earlier this Spring, and now has finally confirmed it’s going to be launching an English dub with Crunchyroll later this year. One Piece made a major change for the anime when it returned this year .
author: ComicBook

title: Web Manga 'Mii-chan to Yamada-san' Gets Anime Adaptation in 2027
content: Production company Kodansha announced an anime adaptation of Nene Azuki 's Mii-chan to Yamada-san ( Mii-chan and Miss Yamada ) web manga on Sunday and revealed an illustration (pictured) drawn by Azuki to commemorate the announcement. The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: New Avatar: The Last Airbender Movie Now Officially Streaming After Leak & Other Release Troubles
content: Avatar: The Last Airbender has officially made its return with a brand new movie that you can now find streaming , and it’s been a very tough road to get to this point. Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender is a brand new adventure from Nickelodeon, Paramount Pictures and Avatar Studios that features a story set years after…

title: Third Season of New 'Ranma ½' Anime Announces Additional Cast
content: The official website of the new Ranma ½ anime series revealed additional cast and a key visual (pictured) for its third season on Saturday. The anime series adapting Rumiko Takahashi 's romantic comedy manga will premiere on Nippon Television at 12.55 a.m. on October 4.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Bleach’s Final Season Confirms Disappointing Episode Count For Hulu Return
content: Hulu has confirmed how many episodes Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War’ s final season is going to be running for, and it’s going to disappoint fans who have been looking forward to the anime’s grand finale.
author: ComicBook

title: BLEACH: TYBW Part 4 - The Calamity Opening & Ending Movie Videos Revealed
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 The Calamity revealed the opening and ending movie videos following the anime’s premiere today. The anime begins today, July 25, following its first three episodes’ early release in US theaters . Hulu recently confirmed that it will run for 10 episodes .
author: Anime Corner
